title: Breaking Down the Israel–Iran Conflict: What We Know So Far - Day 8
byline: This guide answers the most important questions about the Israel Iran war that is unfolding right now. The United States and Israel have launched major military strikes on Iran and Iran has responded with missile attacks across the region. This is one of the most serious escalations in the Middle East in years.

title: How is Sri Lanka responding to the Israel–Iran conflict: Day 8
byline: As tensions escalate between Israel and Iran, Sri Lanka has taken a series of diplomatic, aviation and precautionary measures to manage potential fallout and safeguard its citizens. Here is how Sri Lanka is responding.

title: INDOPACOM rejects Iran’s claim that sunken warship IRIS Dena was unarmed
byline: The United States Indo-Pacific Command (INDOPACOM) has rejected claims that the Iranian warship IRIS Dena was unarmed when it was sunk in a submarine attack near Sri Lankan waters, stating that the vessel was a legitimate military target under the Law of Armed Conflict.

title: Trump rejects settling Iran war, raises prospect of killing all its potential leaders
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said he is not interested in negotiating with Iran and raised the possibility that the Iran war would only end once Tehran no longer has a functioning military or any remaining leadership in power.

title: U.S. respects Sri Lanka’s decision on Iranian warship incident
byline: The United States has said it respects Sri Lanka’s sovereignty in handling matters related to the Iranian warship IRIS Bushehr and its crew.

title: Fire reported at shop in Maharagama
byline: A blaze erupted at a shop in Maharagama town earlier today.

title: Trump tells Britain he does not need its help to win Iran war
byline: President Donald Trump said on Saturday that Britain is giving ’’serious thought’’ to ​sending two aircraft carriers to the Middle East, but added ‌that the U.S. does not need them to win the war with Iran, in the latest clash between the military allies.

title: Explosion reported outside US embassy in Oslo, police say
byline: Police in Norway have cordoned off the area around the US embassy in Oslo after an explosion was reported there.

title: Leopards spotted inside Peradeniya University, safety notice issued
byline: The University of Peradeniya has issued a safety notice to students and staff following several reported leopard sightings within the university premises.

title: Western Province schoolchildren rally for a future without road accidents
byline: Hundreds of schoolchildren from across the Western Province gathered in Colombo yesterday to promote road safety through art at a special competition aimed at creating awareness about preventing road accidents.

title: CEB employees granted 25% salary increase amid restructuring
byline: All employees of the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) have been granted a 25 percent salary increase as part of the transition to the newly established successor companies under the ongoing restructuring of Sri Lanka’s electricity sector.

title: 22 Iranian sailors from IRIS Dena moved to Koggala Air Force Base
byline: Twenty-two sailors from the Iranian naval ship IRIS Dena who were rescued following the attack near Sri Lankan waters have been transferred to the Koggala Air Force Base after receiving treatment at hospital.

title: Small oil patches reported off Hikkaduwa
byline: Small oil patches that were reported on seas off Hikkaduwa and Dodanduwa have been inspected by the Marine Environment Protection Authority (MEPA), its Chairman Samantha Gunasekara said.

title: Panel picking Iran’s next supreme leader has reached consensus, members say
byline: The body tasked with selecting Iran’s new supreme leader has reached a decision, several members said Sunday, although the name has yet to be announced.

title: ’’Will position Sri Lanka as “Sri Lanka of Humanity” on global stage: President
byline: The Sri Lankan nation will be branded before the world as a nation that has taken up the banner of humanity among those who support and bless it in any conflict that arises in the world, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said today.

title: Sri Lanka grants one-month free visas to rescued Iranian sailors
byline: The government will grant free one-month visas to a group rescued from Iranian vessels, allowing them to remain in Sri Lanka under humanitarian protection, Minister of Public Security Ananda Wijepala said.

title: ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026: Complete Statistical Overview
byline: This complete statistical overview of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 highlights the standout performers who shaped the tournament, showcasing the key players and performances that defined the competition.

title: ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026: The Final Chapter – From Super 8s to Champions
byline: The ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 has come to an exciting conclusion after weeks of competitive cricket. The tournament began with the group stage, progressed through the Super 8s, and featured thrilling knockout matches that determined the finalists. In the end, India were crowned champions, defeating New Zealand in the final to lift the T20 World Cup trophy.

title: India rout New Zealand to Clinch record third T20 World Cup
byline: India thrashed New Zealand by 96 runs to become the first team to defend their T20 World Cup title and win a record third crown in Ahmedabad on Sunday.
